title: Ancient Whispers
next_chapter_hook: As the voice faded, Chen Ji felt a burning sensation from the third page of the Tianji Record—Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a rare hint of urgency: 'It has found you, faster than I anticipated.'

text.content: The vertical pupil on the third page of the Tianji Record writhed like a living creature, as if a giant eye from the abyss was slowly opening. Chen Ji felt an unprecedented dizziness, as if the gaze of that vertical pupil had penetrated the barriers of flesh and was looking directly into the depths of his soul. The surrounding air suddenly congealed, and even breathing became unbearably difficult.

An invisible pressure poured down from the vertical pupil, carrying the aura of primordial antiquity. Chen Ji's Brow Center throbbed with intense pain, as if something was trying to force its way into his Mental Sea. He gritted his teeth, veins bulging on his forehead, hands instinctively clenching into fists.

Seemingly awakening within the depths of that vertical pupil, fragmented visions flickered before Chen Ji's eyes like a shattered mirror—endless darkness, burning stars, and a whisper spanning countless ages. The voice was ancient and majestic, as if carrying the memories of the world's initial creation.

choice.prompt: The ancient consciousness is probing the boundaries of your Mental Sea. The forcibly invading will is like an icy, bone-penetrating torrent. How should you respond?

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as a medium, proactively accept this ancient consciousness. Perhaps key information can be obtained from it. The risk is potential complete erosion of consciousness.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain fragmentary memories of the ancient existence
choices.risk_hint: Risk of mental confusion if counteracted

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath and proactively withdrew the defenses at the edge of his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record glowed faintly, as if sensing his intention. He felt a vast flood of information instantly surge in—interwoven with broken images and ancient memories.

choices.text: Seal the Mental Sea with the Tianji Record
choices.description: Using the Tianji Record's power to construct a barrier at the periphery of the Mental Sea, forcibly blocking this invading consciousness. Conservative but safe. May miss the opportunity to obtain information.
choices.visible_cost: The third page of the Tianji Record may be damaged
choices.risk_hint: The ancient consciousness may become enraged

text.content: Chen Ji's mind focused. Symbols on the Tianji Record flickered, and a golden light screen abruptly formed at the edge of his Mental Sea. The ancient consciousness's invasion was forcibly blocked outside. The light within the vertical pupil trembled violently, as if provoked.

The ancient consciousness seemed to sense Chen Ji's resistance, letting out a low, contemptuous laugh. That laughter carried ten thousand years of arrogance and disdain, as if observing an ant attempting to shake a mighty tree. A more immense pressure suddenly descended, causing Chen Ji's blood and qi to surge throughout his body.

dialogue.content: 「A mere ant dares to obstruct this one's gaze? The Tianji Record chose you, but that does not mean you have the qualification to refuse this one's blessing.」

text.content: The voice did not come from the outside world but resounded directly in the depths of Chen Ji's Mental Sea, like the voice of the Great Dao. Each character carried world-destroying power. Chen Ji felt a violent wave of nausea, as if all the blood in his body was flowing backward.

At this moment, the first page of the Tianji Record glowed faintly. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul voice transmitted: 'Do not resist directly. It is not something you can withstand. But also do not completely open up—ask it one question.'

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's reminder struck like a thunderclap. You speak to ask a question amid resistance, but what should you ask?

choices.text: Ask about the meaning of 'Heavenly Secrets'
choices.description: Directly inquire about its understanding of 'Heavenly Secrets'. Perhaps this can uncover the true secrets of the Tianji Record.
choices.risk_hint: May expose your desire for this knowledge

dialogue.content: 「Heavenly Secrets?」 The voice paused for a moment, letting out a meaningful laugh, 「That is a prison, shackles, barriers preventing you mortals from ever touching the truth. And this one... is precisely the weaver of this barrier.」

choices.text: Confront it about its relationship with Chen Xuan
choices.description: Directly confront it about why it knows you are Chen Xuan's successor. Perhaps this can uncover the truth about your master's disappearance.
choices.visible_cost: May allow it to see through your weakness
choices.visible_reward: Obtain related information about Chen Xuan
choices.risk_hint: Expose that Chen Xuan is important to you

dialogue.content: 「Chen Xuan?」 The voice turned cold, 「That ant who stole this one's fragments and fled? He thought he was plotting the world, but little did he know that everything about him... is on this one's chessboard. Including you.」

text.content: Chen Ji's heart sank violently. Everything about Chen Xuan was on its chessboard? Then his plans, his patience, all his scheming through the years... were they merely jokes in the eyes of this ancient existence? An unprecedented fear and fury rose in his heart simultaneously.

「Angry?」 The voice seemed to see through everything about him, 「This is precisely what this one desires. Emotions are the shackles of life, and you ants forever struggle within your shackles, thinking yourselves protagonists. How laughable.」

Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the turbulence in his heart. He recalled Mo Xiansheng's teachings—never let an opponent see your true emotional fluctuations. He took a deep breath, his face returning to the calm of a废物 disciple, even a faint hint of sarcasm curling at the corner of his lips.

dialogue.content: 「Since everything is on Senior's chessboard, then why would Senior bother specifically seeing me? Would it not be simpler to simply manipulate the pieces?」

text.content: That ancient existence fell silent for a moment. This silence made Chen Ji feel a flicker of unease—it seemed to be re-examining him. A more profound pressure descended once more. This time, the light within that vertical pupil condensed sharply, as if intending to completely pierce through his soul.

dialogue.content: 「Interesting.」 For the first time, a trace of genuine interest appeared in that voice, 「Chen Xuan's successor... has finally arrived. This one has waited... for a very long time.」

text.content: Before the words finished, the vertical pupil abruptly contracted, and a destructive force began to condense. At this moment, the Tianji Record erupted with blinding golden light, enveloping Chen Ji entirely. Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out urgently: 'Enough! Today ends here!'

Golden light collided violently with the vertical pupil's gaze. The third page of the Tianji Record trembled intensely, the vertical pupil upon it seemingly erased by some force. Meanwhile, a sharp pain pierced Chen Ji's Brow Center. He felt something added to his Mental Sea—a blurred coordinate and the lingering resonance of a voice.

When the golden light faded, Chen Ji collapsed to the ground, gasping for breath. A faint crack had appeared at the edge of his Mental Sea, and the stabbing pain at his Brow Center lingered unceasingly. The third page of the Tianji Record returned to blankness, but within that emptiness, something seemed to be slowly taking shape.

Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded once more, carrying unprecedented gravity this time: 'You have touched the marginal will of the Heavenly Dao. It is no ordinary enemy—it is the rule of this world itself. From now on, you have been marked by it.'」
